svg.text: D01E ENGINEERING BLUEPRINT — System Architecture (MAIN + J9 + IO)
Fase 1 · FIXED 5V · DevKitC plug-in · Blueprint layout v2 (koridor wiring) · Electrical v3.7
PCB-01 D01E-MAIN-CTRL (~120×90 mm) — otak + sensor + panel + comms
GPIO/Pin: HTR L15=13 · DRM L13=12 · PWM R15=2
Note: Flash USB DevKit · U11 DNP
HEATER_EN GPIO13 · DRUM_EN GPIO12 = Active HIGH = ON
COOL_EN PCF8574 P3 = Active LOW = ON
BTN_* = Active LOW ON · ESTOP_SENSE HIGH = UNSAFE
U3 = FIXED 5V ≥3A · K1 = LC1D25JD 12V · SSR = Crydom D2440
KORIDOR A — power stubs (+5V / +3V3) · jangan taruh komponen di sini
L5 POT_AIR · L6 NTC · L7 UART2_RX · L8 UART2_TX · L9 BTN_DRUM · L10 BTN_HEATER · L11 BTN_AIR
L12 ESTOP · L13 DRUM_EN · L14 GND · L15 HEATER_EN · L19 +5V_SYS
R2 MOSI · R3 SCL · R6 SDA · R8 MISO · R9 SCK · R10 CS_BEAN · R11 UART1_TX · R12 UART1_RX
R13 DFPLAYER_TX · R15 EXHAUST_PWM · R16 CS_ENV · L1 3V3=NC board · flash pins=NC
POWER: J9.1 +12V → U3 → +5V_SYS → U1/U6/U10/U13 · U2 → +3V3_ANA → U4/U5
COMMS: SPI→U4/U5 · I2C→U10 · UART1→U6→J3 · UART2→J_H1 Nextion · GPIO4→U13
KORIDOR B — SPI bus + +3V3 ke TC · label NET di koridor ini
Note: BTN Active LOW · ESTOP HIGH=unsafe
GPIO/Pin: P9 POT · P12/13 UART2 · P15/16 RS485
GPIO/Pin: UART1 GPIO17/16 · DE via PCF
KORIDOR C — control ke J9 + input panel (label NET hanya di koridor)
J9 IDC BRIDGE — ribbon MAIN ↔ IO (pin1 / segel merah sama arah)
Ribbon 15–25 cm · JANGAN tertukar J_H1 · salah orientasi = rusak board
PCB-02 D01E-IO-PWR — industrial power (Fase1 LOCKED diskrit)
HEATER_EN → R_G1 → Q_K1 → K1 coil + SSR → J5
AC: F4 → F1 → K1 → SSR1 → J5
IO diskrit — jangan diganti modul Fase 1
Net names = KiCad net names (jangan rename)
CARA PAKAI BLUEPRINT INI DI KICAD (JUNIOR)
1. Placement: L2_MAIN_PLACEMENT_ZONES · USB DevKit menghadap tepi/atas silk.
2. Route POWER dulu (+12V_IN, +5V_SYS, +3V3_ANA, GND) sesuai L3_02.
3. Route SPI pendek ke U4/U5 · lalu I2C · UART · GPIO kontrol ke J9.
4. Setiap panah + label NET = nama net KiCad — jangan rename.
6. DRC 0 · positions.csv jangan masih WROOM / MP1584EN SOT / L4.
Truth: pcb_nets.py · Electrical v3.7 · BOM Production · config.h
Blueprint arsitektur — bukan Gerber. Regen seats modul sebelum fab.
